tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be a registered company in India as per the Indian Companies Act 1956/ 2013 or Partnership firm as per Partnership Act 1932 or Proprietary Concern and is in the business for the last 3 years (i.e., year 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) as on 31.03.2025)

The Bidder should have executed similar projects (Supply and Installation of Scanners) of value not less than Rs.75 Lakh in one of the last Five financial years (i.e., year2020-21,2021-22 ,2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) as on 31.03.2025) to any of the State Government or Central Government departments or State/ Central Public Sector Units or Private Institutions

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of work orders and Satisfactory Work Completion certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidders should have, supplied and Installed similar projects (Supply and Installation of Scanners of 15 number in a Single year to any Government Dept/ Boards/ Local Bodies/ Government organizations/ Public or Reputed Private Sector Undertakings during last three financial years2020-21,2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of work orders and Satisfactory Work Completion certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: As on date of Notification of Bid, the Bidder shall not be under any declaration of ineligibility for unsatisfactory past performance, corrupt or fraudulent practices, any other unethical business practices or blacklisted either by Government of India or State Governments or any public-sector units of State and Central Governments.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Notarized Affidavit from the Authorized Signatory

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have a consolidated minimum positive Net Worth as on the last day of each of the preceding 3 financial years (i.e., year 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) as on 31.03.2025)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Chartered Accountant Certificate specifying the Net Worth for the specified years.
